summary: The Phase 7R Review B gate passes at audited head b5cab6da. The script imports no database, network, or cloud module, and writes only its --out-json path. No secret, URL with a password, token, or new absolute /home/ path sits in the 22 committed files of 3a929928..b5cab6da. Every committed file holds 0 Thai characters. The map holds ids and counts only, and no lesson text. A bad --out-json or --content-root path writes nothing outside the repo. Two nonblocking hardening items remain: a wrong --duplicates shape writes an empty map with exit 0, and a failed write raises an uncaught error instead of exit 2.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] review-b: dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:93-94: a --duplicates file with no groups key, or with an empty groups array, yields a map with 0 map rows and 550 newIds rows, and main returns 0. The write at dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:231 then replaces the named --out-json file with that empty map. Rationale: readKeepGroups defaults a missing groups key to an empty array, and no check rejects zero kept ids. A wrong input file thus replaces the Phase 7 injector input with an empty map, and exit 0 reports success. The tool is local and run-only, and the operator names every path, so this is a hardening gap and not a break of the Phase 7R scope.

F2 [Nit] review-b: dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:231: the write sits outside the try block at dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:224-230, so a bad --out-json raises an uncaught ENOENT or EISDIR with a stack trace instead of the exit 2 path. Rationale: the probes left the scratch folder empty, so no partial file and no file outside the repo appears. The run only prints a stack trace.
evidence: Thai filter ran first, before any read of the committed files. A script scanned git diff --name-only 3a929928..b5cab6da for U+0E00 to U+0E7F and printed counts per file. All 22 files hold thai_chars=0.

dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:231 holds the only fs.writeFileSync call, and it writes options.outJson. The other fs calls are reads: readFileSync at line 93, readdirSync at line 109, existsSync at lines 107 and 218.

The script never opens a content/primary package file. listPackages at dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:108-112 lists file names only, and the module guard at lines 236-237 keeps the run call out of import.

Every keepId is a cuid string and every package id is a book/lesson string.

The only /home/ hits are the vitest banner path in 9 captures and the literal /home/ assertion at dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.test.ts:329 and :466.
